title: PCA Tech Q&A - 993 suspension alignment specifications
notes: Club expert restating factory street settings: front total toe +5' +/-5', camber -20' +/-10', caster 5 deg 20'; rear toe +10' +/-5' per wheel, camber -1 deg 10' +/-15'. Rear toe revised from 15' per wheel (MY1995) to 10' (MY1996 onward). Setup data, not part geometry; suspension stays a restricted class under SAFETY.md.
